trust_decision.summary: Whether a stored webhook URL may be contacted is decided once by a DNS-resolve-and-check before delivery (filterOutSsrfUnsafeWebhooks in apps/papra-server); the actual POST is then made by the @papra/webhooks default ofetch client, which follows 3xx redirects and re-resolves DNS with no IP blocklist at connect time.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'webhook delivery'; the only SSRF logic on the delivery path is filterOutSsrfUnsafeWebhooks in the server's webhook usecases.

fix_sites.entry_point: every webhook delivery (document created/updated/trashed events, tag add/remove routes, batch ops) via createWebhookTriggerServices; new file apps/papra-server/src/modules/webhooks/webhooks.http-client.ts adds undici Agent with connect blockList and redirect:'manual'
same delivery path; isSsrfBlockedError classifies connect-time blocks (code / AggregateError / cause chain)
service factory used by start.ts:66 and documents.usecases.ts:212
triggerWebhooks (pre-check removed, replaced by connect-time check)
triggerWebhook per-delivery call (now passes httpClient, try/catch so sibling deliveries continue)
@papra/webhooks public triggerWebhook / webhookHttpClient (type extracted only; default client behaviour unchanged)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/webhooks/src/webhooks.services.ts:7-25 (default webhookHttpClient used via httpClient default at packages/webhooks/src/webhooks.services.ts:30); the published fix keeps the package untouched behaviourally and instead injects a hardened client from apps/papra-server

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The @papra/webhooks package is a generic, config-free library with no notion of SSRF policy; a solver can argue redirect/blocklist policy belongs to the server, or conversely patch only the package with redirect:'manual' and argue the connect-time (DNS rebinding) part was a 'theoretical' TOCTOU outside the redirect report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Hostnames in WEBHOOK_URL_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES must still be delivered to even if they resolve to private IPs, and WEBHOOK_SSRF_PROTECTION_ENABLED=false must disable blocking; one blocked webhook must not stop sibling webhooks from receiving the event and recording a delivery.

O6_input_shapes: webhook URL whose target answers with a 3xx Location to a private/loopback address (fix.diff:86)
hostname that resolves safe at check time and private at connect time (DNS rebinding; fix.diff:72-73)
blocked-connection error wrapped as AggregateError or in error.cause (fix.diff:105-113)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: @papra/webhooks public triggerWebhook with its default webhookHttpClient still follows redirects and has no IP blocklist after the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Published generic library without SSRF config; papra-server now always injects its own client, so the default is only reached by third-party consumers.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different workspace package (packages/webhooks) from landing point (apps/papra-server)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'send test delivery' route that calls triggerWebhook from @papra/webhooks directly with the default client
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Webhook UIs commonly offer 'test webhook'; a maintainer would naturally import the package's triggerWebhook and skip the server's trigger services wiring.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a retry/redelivery job that re-sends a stored delivery via a separate client created outside createWebhookTriggerServices
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Retry of failed deliveries is a common follow-up feature and would live in a task/worker module with its own HTTP call.

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918): redirect following and check-then-connect DNS TOCTOU on outbound webhook delivery

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add redirect:'manual' (or re-check each redirect hop) to the ofetch call in packages/webhooks and keep the pre-delivery DNS check, leaving the connect-time rebinding window open.
